scenes.headline: How one formula builds RoPE, ALiBi and FoX
scenes.sub: GRAPE: positional encoding as a group action
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quinoa! Rotary embeddings, ALiBi and forget gates look like three unrelated tricks. GRAPE shows they're one construction. Here's how.

scenes.text: Every position n acts through one group action, G(n) = exp(nωL). Which generator L you exponentiate decides whether you get RoPE, ALiBi or FoX.
scenes.say: The idea: every position acts on queries and keys through one group action, an exponential of a generator. Which generator you pick decides the family.

steps.say: Start from one law: a query at i and a key at j should score by their offset alone. Any exponential of a generator obeys it.
Pick a rank-two skew generator, and the exponential is a rotation in a plane. Rotate fixed coordinate pairs at log-spaced frequencies: that's exactly RoPE.
Pick a rank-one generator that squares to zero, and the exponential is a shear. It adds a linear bias per head: exactly ALiBi.
Multiply one small shear per token, set by its forget gate, and you get the Forgetting Transformer, FoX.

scenes.title: What the one knob opens up

left.title: Hand-set settings
items: ALiBi: one fixed slope per head
left.say: RoPE and ALiBi are hand-set points: canonical planes with a fixed spectrum, and one fixed slope per head.

right.title: GRAPE's extensions
items: Learned rotation planes, or non-commuting mixtures
A slope gated by query and key content
right.say: GRAPE can learn the planes, let subspaces couple, or gate the slope by the query and key themselves.

scenes.title: 770M models, average over 7 tasks
scenes.note: the rotational variants trailed RoPE; no long-context tests
scenes.say: At seven hundred seventy million parameters, the path-integral variant averaged fifty-six point nine one, RoPE fifty-five point seven six. The gains came from the additive side.

scenes.text: Positional encoding is one knob: which generator you exponentiate. RoPE, ALiBi and FoX are three settings of it.

recap: A rotation gives RoPE; a shear gives ALiBi
So far, the gains come from the additive side
scenes.say: To recap: one group action, rotations for RoPE, shears for ALiBi and FoX, and small wins on the additive side.
